neon1's own names

TermMeaning
neon1The name neon1 LLC does business under. Always lowercase. See the names
neon1 LLCThe company, formed in New York on July 24, 2025
1NEONThe client workspace and portal, pronounced "onion": layers for purpose, plan, work, files, decisions, care, and exit
NeoThe chat assistant on neon1.tech. It answers only from neon1's public documents
CLIPCommand-Line Interface Plus. AWS CLIP, a pre-release tool, puts account guards and approval checks around the AWS command line. Its own previews show the service, operation, and policy decision and leave argument values out. What AWS prints isn't filtered
DeployOpsCloud automation, public and in development: pipelines for infrastructure and applications on any major cloud
Ready, Secure, GoA security readiness guide for homes and small businesses, public and in development
N1 Supply LLCA separate company for product experiments, with the same owner
neon1-corpusThe public repository where every neon1 document is written once
1 is glad to be of serviceneon1's slogan, from Bicentennial Man
Needs, Execute, Observe, NormalizeThe four parts of every neon1 case study, which spell NEON

Working together

TermMeaning
DiscoveryLearning one real task before proposing anything
BaselineHow the task performs before any change
ScopeWhat's included, what isn't, and how we'll know it's done
Change requestA written, priced change to agreed scope, approved before work
AcceptanceYour recorded decision that the work passed its agreed checks
HandoverThe point where you can run it without me, with instructions, ownership, and exports
CareOptional scheduled attention to a named workflow, within an agreed allowance

Reliability

TermMeaning
SLIService level indicator: what's measured, such as the share of requests handled correctly
SLOService level objective: the target for an SLI over a set window
SLAService level agreement: a contractual promise with consequences
RTORecovery time objective: the longest acceptable time to restore a service
RPORecovery point objective: how much recent data you can afford to lose
3-2-1 backupThree copies, two kinds of storage, one away from the building
Restore testBringing data back from a backup to prove it works
IncidentSomething that disrupts or threatens normal work

Security and privacy

TermMeaning
MFAMulti-factor authentication: a second proof of identity beyond a password
Least privilegeGiving each person or system only the access the job needs
PhishingA message pretending to be someone trusted, to steal access or money
PHIProtected health information under HIPAA
HIPAAThe U.S. law that governs health information privacy and security
BAABusiness associate agreement: required before a vendor handles PHI for a health practice
SOC 2An independent audit report on a company's security controls
NIST CSFThe NIST Cybersecurity Framework, a map of security responsibilities
WCAGWeb Content Accessibility Guidelines. neon1.tech aims for version 2.2, level AA

Cloud and AI

TermMeaning
IaCInfrastructure as code: cloud resources described in reviewed files instead of clicked into a console
CI/CDAutomated checks and deploys that run on every change
RAGRetrieval-augmented generation: an AI assistant that answers from your own documents
Evaluation setReal examples with expected answers, used to test an AI system before anyone relies on it
Prompt injectionText hidden in a document or web page that tries to make an AI system misbehave
FinOpsManaging cloud cost with a budget, an owner, and regular review
